title: A ramped clip's bar is tinted by its speed bands, with the mock's legend under it
goal: On the timeline, a clip whose speed changes across it shows where it is slow, normal, fast or frozen on the clip bar itself, coloured the way the speed mock colours it, with the mock's small legend under the clip, so an editor reads the retime at a glance without opening the speed curve.
notes: Mock: docs/design/mocks/pages/video-speed.html .vs-cells/.vs-cell (48 sampled cells, gradients per band) and .seglegend. The bands per clip are SpeedCurve(clipPieces).bands (Sources/PhotonzCore/SpeedCurve.swift), already tested; the clip bar is ClipPiecesBar.swift. Filed from the-speed-curve-shows-under-a-clip-and-its-stops, whose audit lists both as mock differences.
acceptance: A clip with speed stops draws the mock's band cells along its bar: Slow-mo #12c2e9, Normal #9a5cff, Fast #ff5d8f, Freeze hatched amber, where the stops put them
The mock's legend (Slow-mo, Normal, Fast, Freeze, held) shows under a ramped clip while its speed curve is open, and nowhere else
The clip name stays legible over every band in light and dark

The speed curve's title placement is settled against the mock (the mock heads the plot with SPEED CURVE above it; the app labels it in the track gutter like its other lanes): a decision card if the gutter is kept
On a 1280 by 800 window, opening a clip's speed curve leaves the clip's own bar and the curve both in view at once (measured in a walk on the laptop window)

Measured bar: a pixel sampled at the middle of each band on the clip bar is within 10 of the mock's colour for that band in each channel, and a clip with no stops samples the same as today. Today's bar (one colour whatever the speed) fails it

log.note: digest 2026-10-18: the speed curve audit (queue/audits/2026-10-17-speed-curve.json, rough) says that on a 1280 by 800 window the timeline shows about 106 pt of tracks, so opening the 104 pt curve scrolls the clip mostly out of sight. The tint and legend on the bar are only useful if the bar stays on screen while the curve is open. Acceptance widened.
digest 2026-10-18: added a measured bar the weak version fails.
